topics.name: Processes and Threads
topics.description: Process control block (PCB), process states, thread models (user vs kernel), context switching overhead.

topics.name: CPU Scheduling
topics.description: FCFS, SJF, SRTF, Round Robin, Priority scheduling algorithms, turnaround time, waiting time, and Gantt charts.

topics.name: Process Synchronization
topics.description: Critical section problem, Peterson's solution, semaphores, mutex locks, classical synchronization problems (Producer-Consumer, Dining Philosophers).

topics.name: Deadlocks
topics.description: Four Coffman conditions, Resource Allocation Graphs (RAG), Banker's algorithm for avoidance, detection and recovery.

topics.name: Main Memory and Paging
topics.description: Contiguous memory allocation, paging, Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB), effective memory access time, multilevel paging, inverted page tables.

topics.name: Virtual Memory and Page Replacement
topics.description: Demand paging, page fault handling, Belady's anomaly, FIFO, Optimal (MIN), LRU page replacement algorithms, thrashing and working set model.

topics.name: File Systems and Disk Scheduling
topics.description: File allocation methods (contiguous, linked, indexed), UNIX inode structure, disk scheduling algorithms (FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK, C-LOOK).

topics.name: Asymptotic Analysis and Recurrences
topics.description: Big-O, Omega, Theta notations, Master Theorem for divide-and-conquer recurrences, recursion tree method, substitution method.

topics.name: Divide and Conquer
topics.description: Binary search, Merge Sort, Quick Sort (best, worst, average case analysis), counting inversions, median finding.

topics.name: Greedy Algorithms
topics.description: Greedy-choice property, Fractional Knapsack, Activity Selection / Interval Scheduling, Huffman Coding, optimal merge patterns.

topics.name: Dynamic Programming
topics.description: Optimal substructure, overlapping subproblems, 0/1 Knapsack, Longest Common Subsequence (LCS), Matrix Chain Multiplication (MCM), Subset Sum.

topics.name: Graph Traversals and Connectivity
topics.description: Breadth-First Search (BFS), Depth-First Search (DFS), topological sort in DAGs, strongly connected components (Kosaraju, Tarjan).

topics.name: Shortest Paths and MST
topics.description: Dijkstra's single-source shortest path, Bellman-Ford algorithm, Floyd-Warshall all-pairs, Prim's and Kruskal's algorithms for Minimum Spanning Tree (MST).

topics.name: ER Model and Relational Model
topics.description: Entity-Relationship (ER) diagrams, weak entities, mapping ER to relational schemas, primary, candidate, super, and foreign keys, integrity constraints.

topics.name: Relational Algebra and Calculus
topics.description: Fundamental relational algebra operations (Select, Project, Cartesian product, Union, Set Difference, Rename), Join variants (Natural, Outer, Theta), Tuple and Domain Relational Calculus.

topics.name: SQL Queries and Constraints
topics.description: Complex nested subqueries, GROUP BY, HAVING, aggregate functions, NULL handling, correlated subqueries, set operations, view definitions.

topics.name: Functional Dependencies and Normalization
topics.description: Functional dependencies, closure of attributes, minimal covers, 1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF, lossless join decomposition, dependency preservation.

topics.name: Transactions and Concurrency Control
topics.description: ACID properties, serializability (conflict and view serializability), precedence graphs, Two-Phase Locking (2PL, Strict 2PL, Rigorous 2PL), deadlock prevention and timestamp ordering.

topics.name: Indexing and B/B+ Trees
topics.description: Primary, secondary, clustering indexes, sparse vs dense indexing, B-Trees and B+ Trees node capacity, insertion, deletion, height and block access calculations.
